key_insight: Introducing MAC, the first public CVR benchmark that provides conversion labels under multiple attribution mechanisms, enabling models to learn from and be evaluated on diverse attribution signals for better multi-attribution learning (MAL).
problem_solved: Public CVR datasets use a single attribution mechanism, blocking development and evaluation of MAL approaches that require labels derived from multiple attribution rules.
method: Construct a CVR dataset (MAC) where each conversion event is labeled under several attribution mechanisms instead of just one.
Provide standardized data splits and baseline evaluations to enable fair comparison of MAL methods.
Facilitate research by releasing the benchmark and associated evaluation protocols for multi-attribution learning.
impact: MAC enables ML practitioners and researchers to train and benchmark models that are robust to attribution choice, improving conversion prediction and decision-making in advertising systems and other user-conversion applications.
visual_elements: Diagram showing one conversion event mapped to multiple attribution labels (e.g., last-click, time-decay, multi-touch)

paper_title: MAC: A Conversion Rate Prediction Benchmark Featuring Labels Under Multiple Attribution Mechanisms
paper_authors: Jinqi Wu, Sishuo Chen, Zhangming Chan, Yong Bai, Lei Zhang
